_comment: Curated quarterly MHCLG delivery history. Each point cites its source document and raw upstream figure. Leading 2019–2022 points use the 24 September 2026 official live-table vintage, with archived workbooks and cell-level provenance; existing later components retain their original vintages and values.

housing_trajectory.rationale: Quarterly new-build dwelling completions (seasonally adjusted), annualised by x4 and expressed as a percentage of this tracker's fixed 300,000-homes annual benchmark. This is a benchmark ratio, not an OBR forecast. It uses new-build completions rather than the broader annual net-additional-dwellings measure.
housing_trajectory.primary_source: MHCLG Housing supply: indicators of new supply quarterly releases (headline 'Completions (seasonally adjusted)' figure)
housing_trajectory.trajectory_source: Fixed tracker benchmark of 300,000 homes per year, preserved for series continuity. It is not a measured annual outturn or an OBR forecast.
housing_trajectory.implemented_in: Implemented in packages/shared/src/derivations.ts (single code home; drift-guarded by packages/data-sources/src/fixtures/housingDerivation.test.ts — a value/raw pair that disagrees with the formula fails CI). This prose block remains the rationale + primary-source citation record.

planning_consents.rationale: Major plus minor residential planning applications granted in the quarter, expressed as a percentage of the tracker's fixed estimated 11,500 quarterly benchmark. The September 2026 official P120A workbook gives exact calendar 2019 quarter counts 11,201, 10,900, 11,464 and 11,133 (mean 11,174.5). The original 11,500 approximation is preserved for continuity; it is not the exact official mean. Applications are not dwelling units.
planning_consents.primary_source: MHCLG Planning applications in England quarterly releases and live Table P120A, major applications granted (column D) plus minor applications granted (column L).
planning_consents.implemented_in: Implemented in packages/shared/src/derivations.ts (single code home; drift-guarded by packages/data-sources/src/fixtures/housingDerivation.test.ts — a value/raw pair that disagrees with the formula fails CI). This prose block remains the rationale + primary-source citation record.

baseline_note: Each indicator covers 2019 Q1 through 2026 Q2. Leading 13 housing and 15 planning observations were extracted from the official 24 September 2026 current-vintage workbooks. Existing 2022–2026 components retain their previously recorded values and publication metadata. Source vintages are mixed; this is current-revision baseline history, not an as-known-at-the-time archive. COVID 2020 Q2 remains excluded from scoring baselines by existing policy.
